morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1842-03 KV cache evictions. We need concrete runbook and playbook edits: triage steps, exact commands, escalation matrix, and owners + due dates. Who can take what?
incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-evictions-patterns 14 artifacts + traces attached.
priya: I can own the playbook escalation table and who to page for Dedicated customers. @ash can you draft the minimal triage commands for on-call?
ash: Yep, keeping it minimal so on-call can act in the first 10min. Draft below 4dc please sanity-check: 
```
# KV eviction quick triage
1) pods: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 120 | egrep -i "evict|kv_cache|oom"
3) metrics: curl -fsS http://monitoring.internal/api/metrics?svc=runtime | jq '.kv_cache_evictions, .mem.rss, .gpu.util'
4) if evictions > 75/min -> reduce batch & restart:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) post-restart smoke: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && echo '{"prompt":"warmup"}' | http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate
6) if unresolved > 15m -> page @oncall. If Dedicated tenant affected, page @dedicated-esc immediately and cc @support.
```
dan: I'll own runbook edits and push to docs/runbooks/kv-evictions.md. Plan to open PR by 2026-04-05.
tanya: I can make a tiny smoke script for step 5 and put it in a gist for the PR. Will include exit codes so the on-call runbook can call it.
morgan: Can we assign follow-up INCs now so we can track? I'll create them and post IDs here.
priya: Suggested action items: 1) Playbook escalation table (priya) - INC-8123 - due 2026-03-30; 2) Runbook update (dan) - INC-8124 - due 2026-04-05; 3) Triage commands + smoke script (ash + tanya) - INC-8125 - due 2026-03-28.
ash: ACK INC-8125. I'll add auth notes for rt-admin dump and a safe dump command: `curl -u svc-sre:token -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz`
tanya: Gist: https://gist.internal/kv-warmup-check.sh (will link in PR). Script exits 0 on success, 2 on warmup failure.
dan: Opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1984  tagging @priya @ash @tanya for review. ETA merge 2026-04-05 EOD.
morgan: Great. I'll track these INCs in the postmortem follow-ups doc and close the loop when they're resolved. Thanks all :thumbsup:
